exam_scheme.note: The Joint Graduate Entrance Examination for Biology and Interdisciplinary Life Sciences (JGEEBILS) is a shared nationwide entrance examination conducted under the umbrella of the Tata Institute of Fundamental Research (TIFR) Graduate School Admissions (GS) in collaboration with the National Centre for Biological Sciences (NCBS, Bengaluru) and participating research institutions across India (including TIFR Mumbai, TIFR Hyderabad, IISERs, InStem, NII, ACTREC, NBRC, CDFD, SINP, RGCB, and ILS). The examination serves as the screening gateway for admission into Ph.D. and Integrated M.Sc.-Ph.D. degree programmes in Biology and Interdisciplinary Life Sciences. The test is a 3-hour Computer Based Test (CBT) covering General Science/Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, and Biology, testing foundational and analytical problem-solving skills rather than rote memorization. Candidates qualifying JGEEBILS submit individual applications and appear for in-person interviews at participating member institutions.
